title: [LOGGED OUT] Phone "Add It to Home Screen" banner closes with its X

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser with phone emulation (iPhone 14 size, 390x844) and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Home loaded at 390x844 with cookie banner and bottom banner

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Clicked Dismiss (button showed spinner, then banner closed)

steps.text: Is a bottom banner with "Add It to Home Screen" and a green "Claim" button shown?
steps.saw: Bottom banner "Add It to Home Screen" / "To got a quicker access !" with green Claim button and X shown

steps.text: Click the X button at the right of the "Add It to Home Screen" banner. Do not click "Claim".
steps.saw: Clicked X (Close pwa banner); Claim not clicked

steps.text: Is the "Add It to Home Screen" banner gone?
Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store/ in the same tab and wait until the page has finished loading.
Is the "Add It to Home Screen" banner still hidden?
steps.saw: No banner on /store/; snapshot find 'Home Screen' returned no match
